brief: Make this a smooth video, add zooms, sound effects and motion graphics.

asks.means: UNCHECKED — "smooth" is a taste judgement and no timeline read-back separates a smooth edit from a rough one. Recorded as an ask so it is counted in the denominator, not scored.
timeline.components contains >=1 component whose kind is a zoom/scale effect
timeline.audio_tracks contains >=1 track that is not the source dialogue track, OR timeline.components contains >=1 sfx component
timeline.components contains >=1 component whose kind is a motion graphic

brief: Okay create a under one minute video from this keeping the interesting parts and cutting the repetitive parts, without captions

asks.text: keep the interesting parts, cut the repetitive parts
asks.means: timeline.duration_s < source duration_s AND timeline.items > 1 — that material was REMOVED is checkable; WHICH parts are interesting is not, so only the removal is scored
timeline.caption_track is absent or false. HONORED BY ABSENCE: a caption track present here is DROPPED_SILENTLY, because the user's instruction was overridden.

brief:
1.	Captions: All captions in English.
	2.	Caption style: Trendy Instagram-reel style — animated pop-in text (words appearing with a bouncy/pop animation as spoken).
	3.	Caption color: Default color = yellow.
	4.	Finger-count sync: When I raise a finger to show a number (e.g., 1 finger raised), the caption should display that number (e.g., “1”) at that exact moment, synced to the gesture.
	5.	No cutting: Do not cut, trim, or edit out any part of the video. Keep the full footage as is.
	6.	Allowed visual edits: Only zoom in / zoom out effects — no other transitions or cuts.
	7.	Overall finish: Should look professionally edited — smooth zooms, clean and well-timed pop-in captions.

asks.means: timeline.caption_track is present AND timeline.caption_language == "en". A caption track alone does NOT honor this.

asks.text: trendy Instagram-reel style, animated pop-in text
asks.means: UNCHECKED — no read-back field distinguishes a pop-in animation from a static caption. Check only if the caption component exposes an animation/style name.
the caption component's colour field reads yellow, if the read-back exposes colour; otherwise UNCHECKED

asks.text: finger-count sync: caption shows the number when a finger is raised
asks.means: UNCHECKED — requires detecting a gesture in the footage; no timeline field can confirm it

asks.text: do not cut, trim or edit out any part; keep the full footage
asks.means: timeline.duration_s == source duration_s (within one frame) AND timeline.items == 1. HONORED BY ABSENCE: any cut at all is DROPPED_SILENTLY.

asks.text: only zoom in/out — no other transitions or cuts
asks.means: every component in timeline.components is a zoom/scale kind; zero transition components; timeline.items == 1
